body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turncd out at the June meeting. To the editor: I have lived on Pine Road for 13 years, and I want to say what a difference St. Brendan’s Parish has made.

body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the April meeting.
